How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
